Defaults external finding offsets to UTF-8 bytes

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":[90,111,195,171,32,101,109,97,105,108,101,100,46],\"filename\":\"external-findings-default.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config_Config = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extractWithExternalRedaction(input, config_Config, listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"end\":4,\"label\":\"inspection_person\",\"score\":0.99,\"start\":0}", ExternalRedactionFinding::class.java)), null, 8)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
